transitions.name: fade
transitions.author: tiraz
transitions.description: A plain cross-fade drawn with the 2D canvas; works without WebGL.

transitions.name: Accordion
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image folds up like a pleated paper toward one side while the incoming one unfolds out of the other, both in 3D with lit and shadowed pleats

params.name: pleats
params.note: Number of pleats in each image (a pleat is a pair of panels, one lit and one in the shade)

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction in which the images move, snapped to its main axis (left, right, up or down): the outgoing image folds up toward it, the incoming one unfolds from the opposite side

params.name: shading
params.note: Contrast between the lit and the shaded panels

params.name: perspective
params.note: Amount of perspective: the valleys between the pleats recede

transitions.name: ApertureWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A camera aperture opens its turning blades to reveal the incoming image

params.name: blades
params.note: Number of blades

params.name: rotation
params.note: How much the blades turn while opening, in degrees

params.name: shadow
params.note: How dark the blades are shaded along their edges

transitions.name: ArrowWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A notched arrowhead window onto the incoming image flies in from the edge behind it (or appears at the center), then swells until it fills the frame

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the arrow points and flies toward

params.name: notch
params.note: Depth of the notch at the back of the arrowhead (0 for a plain triangle)

params.name: width
params.note: Opening angle of the arrowhead's tip, in degrees

params.name: count
params.note: Number of nested chevrons flying in a row

params.name: origin
params.note: Grow the arrow from the center of the frame instead of flying it in

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the arrow's edges

transitions.name: Ascii
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image turns into text-mode characters, denser where it is brighter, the characters scramble into those of the incoming image, then resolve back into it

params.name: cellSize
params.note: Height of a character, in frame heights

params.name: colored
params.note: Color the characters with the image (otherwise, with the ink color)

transitions.name: BandWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Alternating bands wipe in from opposite sides together and interleave like fingers, while both images stay still

params.name: bands
params.note: Number of bands

params.name: vertical
params.note: Cut the frame into columns that wipe up and down instead of rows that wipe sideways

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the bands' leading edges

params.name: stagger
params.note: Delay between the first and the last band, so they cascade from the top (or the left)

transitions.name: BeadUp
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is a thin film of liquid on glass that pulls itself apart like water on a waxed surface: dry holes open and grow with glossy rolled rims, meet in a web of ridges, the ridges break into round beads that magnify the picture, and the beads dry up over the incoming image

params.name: holes
params.note: Number of rows of holes across the frame

params.name: rim
params.note: Radius of the rims and beads, in frame heights (at most a seventh of the space between holes)

params.name: gloss
params.note: Strength of the reflections and of the magnification in the liquid

transitions.name: BillowWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image flows over the outgoing one like one fluid sliding over another, its front rolling up into a row of curling spirals that wind the two images into each other, tighten as they sweep across the frame and drift sideways, then leave it

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the front travels toward

params.name: spacing
params.note: Distance between the curls, in frame heights

params.name: winding
params.note: How many radians the curls wind up while crossing the frame

params.name: drift
params.note: How far the curls drift sideways while crossing, in frame heights

transitions.name: BlockCover
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Blocks of a solid color pop in at random over the outgoing image until they cover the frame, then pop out in another random order to show the incoming image

params.name: blocks
params.note: Number of blocks along the longer side of the frame (the blocks stay about square)

params.name: pop
params.note: How much a block overshoots its cell as it pops in

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the blocks' edges, in blocks

transitions.name: BlockSlide
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame is cut into a grid of blocks that slide out one after another in a staggered cascade, some of them shrinking as they go, while the blocks of the incoming image slide in behind them to take their place

params.name: grid
params.note: Number of blocks (columns, rows), at most 40 along the direction

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the blocks slide toward (rounded to the nearest axis)

params.name: stagger
params.note: Share of the transition over which the blocks set off one after another (0 slides them all together)

params.name: zoom
params.note: How much the zooming blocks shrink on their way, as a share of their size

transitions.name: BloomDissolve
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The highlights of the outgoing image blow out into a soft, wide glow that floods the frame; under it the incoming image takes over, then the glow subsides back into its highlights while the image stays sharp

params.name: spread
params.note: Reach of the glow at the peak, in frame heights

params.name: threshold
params.note: Brightness above which the image glows (the whole frame does at the peak)

params.name: intensity
params.note: Brightness of the glow

transitions.name: BokehDissolve
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image falls out of focus like a camera lens, its highlights swelling into large bright bokeh discs, and the incoming image sharpens back out of its own bokeh

params.name: radius
params.note: Radius of the bokeh discs at the peak, in frame heights

params.name: blades
params.note: Number of aperture blades, which shape the discs into polygons (below 3: round)

params.name: threshold
params.note: Brightness above which a pixel is a highlight that swells into a disc

params.name: intensity
params.note: Brightness of the bokeh discs

transitions.name: BookFlip
transitions.author: hong
transitions.description: The right half of the outgoing image is a book page that turns over from right to left on the spine at the middle of the frame, curling near its free edge, its back bringing the left half of the incoming image

params.name: perspective
params.note: Strength of the perspective: the page grows as it lifts toward the viewer

params.name: shading
params.note: How much the page darkens as it turns away from the light, and the shadows it casts

params.name: curl
params.note: How much the page bends near its free edge, which trails behind as it turns

transitions.name: Bounce
transitions.author: Adrian Purser
transitions.description: The outgoing image drops out of the frame with a few bounces, revealing the incoming one

params.name: shadow_height
params.note: Height of the shadow, relative to the image height

params.name: bounces
params.note: Number of bounces before settling

transitions.name: BowTie
transitions.author: KMojek
transitions.description: Two triangles grow from the top and bottom edges into a bow tie that reveals the incoming image, with an adjustable shape, and can run in reverse

params.name: reverse
params.note: Run the wipe in reverse

transitions.name: BowTieHorizontal
transitions.author: huynx
transitions.description: Two triangles grow from the left and right edges into a bow tie that reveals the incoming image

transitions.name: BrushWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A few broad brush strokes sweep across the frame in turn, back and forth, painting in the incoming image with streaky bristle edges and dry, ragged ends

params.name: strokes
params.note: Number of brush strokes needed to cover the frame

params.name: angle
params.note: Angle of the strokes, in degrees

params.name: roughness
params.note: How rough the bristles make the edges and ends of the strokes

params.name: waviness
params.note: How much the strokes wave along their way

transitions.name: BurnThrough
transitions.author: liubailin2020@gmail.com
transitions.description: The outgoing image burns away in noisy, glowing patches

transitions.name: ButterflyWaveScrawler
transitions.author: mandubian
transitions.description: Wavy, color-separated ripples scramble the outgoing image into the incoming one

transitions.name: CameraShake
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera jolts violently in random directions, with motion blur and color fringes along each jolt; the cut happens at the peak of the shake, which then settles on the incoming image

params.name: strength
params.note: How far the camera jolts (and rolls) at the peak of the shake

params.name: jolts
params.note: Number of jolts over the transition

params.name: blur
params.note: Length of the motion blur along each jolt

params.name: split
params.note: How far the color channels split apart along each jolt

transitions.name: CardDeal
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image is dealt onto the frame like a hand of cards: tile after tile is flicked from below the frame, spinning through the air with a lifting shadow, and slides to a stop in its place until the picture is complete

params.name: grid
params.note: Number of cards (columns, rows), at most 6 by 6

params.name: deck
params.note: Point the cards are dealt from, can be outside the frame

params.name: spin
params.note: Turns a card makes on its way, before it settles straight

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the shadows the cards cast

transitions.name: CardSwipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is flicked off like the top card of a stack, swinging around a point below it as it flies out, while the incoming card behind it grows to fill the frame

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction in which the outgoing card is flicked

params.name: rotation
params.note: How much the outgoing card swings as it flies out

params.name: depth
params.note: How much smaller the incoming card starts

transitions.name: CellDissolve
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Irregular cells, like cracked mud or soap foam, switch to the incoming image one by one, with an optional bright border glowing along the cracks between them

params.name: cells
params.note: Number of cells across the height of the frame

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Duration of each cell's switch, as a fraction of the transition (0: each cell switches at once)

params.name: border
params.note: Width of the border along the cell edges, in frame heights (0: no border)

params.name: seed
params.note: Random seed: another value gives other cells, switching in another order

transitions.name: Chessboard
transitions.author: lql
transitions.description: A chessboard pattern of squares reveals the incoming image

params.name: grid_num
params.note: Number of squares per row

transitions.name: CircleBurst
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Discs of three solid colors burst out of a point one after another, each covering the last, then a hole bursts open from the same point in the last one to reveal the incoming image

params.name: center
params.note: Point the discs burst out of, in texture coordinates

params.name: stagger
params.note: Delay between the discs, relative to the burst of one disc (at 0, they burst as one: a single circle opens onto the incoming image)

transitions.name: CircleIris
transitions.author: Fernando Kuteken
transitions.description: The outgoing image closes into a circle over a background color, then the incoming one opens from it

params.name: center
params.note: Center of the circle

transitions.name: CircleOpen
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A soft-edged circle opens from the center to reveal the incoming image

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the circle's edge

params.name: opening
params.note: Open the circle; false closes it instead

transitions.name: Cleave
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image is driven into the outgoing one like a wedge into a log: a crack runs ahead of its point, the two halves are shoved aside and bunch up against its sides, then fall apart out of the frame

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the wedge is driven in, snapped to the nearest of the four edge-to-edge directions

params.name: opening
params.note: Half angle of the wedge, in degrees

params.name: squash
params.note: How much the halves bunch up against the wedge instead of sliding away rigidly

params.name: shading
params.note: Strength of the ridge and shadow shading along the split

transitions.name: ClockWipe
transitions.author: Fernando Kuteken
transitions.description: A wipe that sweeps around the center from a starting angle

params.name: startingAngle
params.note: Angle where the wipe starts, in degrees

transitions.name: Clothesline
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera pulls back to show the outgoing image as a print hung by two clothespins on a line in front of a wall, the line is pulled sideways and carries it away while the incoming print slides in, both prints swinging and tilting like hanging paper, then the camera moves back in on the incoming print until it fills the frame

params.name: direction
params.note: Way the line is pulled: 1 brings the incoming print in from the right, -1 from the left

params.name: sway
params.note: How much the prints swing and tilt as the line moves

params.name: size
params.note: Size of the prints when the camera is farthest, as a part of the frame

transitions.name: CodeRain
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image darkens into a grid of flickering code characters tinted by its colors, then glowing streams of characters fall down the columns at their own speeds, each with a bright head and a fading tail, leaving the incoming image behind

params.name: cellSize
params.note: Height of a character, in frame heights

params.name: trail
params.note: Average length of the streams' fading tails, in frame heights

params.name: tint
params.note: How much the characters of the outgoing image take its colors, instead of the glow color

transitions.name: CoinSettle
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image settles onto the outgoing one like a spun coin coming to rest: it starts standing on its edge, then leans over while its lifted side whirls around faster and faster with a sweeping shadow, rocking on its corners in a quickening rattle, until it drops flat and still over the frame

params.name: whirls
params.note: Number of whirls of the lifted side

params.name: twist
params.note: In-plane turn of the image when it stands up, undone as it settles

params.name: shading
params.note: Shading of the coin and darkness of its shadow

transitions.name: ColorCoords
transitions.author: haiyoucuv
transitions.description: A crossfade in which the colors of one image displace the other

transitions.name: ColorDistance
transitions.author: P-Seebauer
transitions.description: Pixels switch to the incoming image in order of how close their colors are

transitions.name: ColorPanelWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Solid color panels, slightly staggered, sweep across and cover the frame, then sweep off the far side and reveal the incoming image

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the panels sweep toward

params.name: panels
params.note: Number of panels

params.name: stagger
params.note: Delay between the panels, relative to the sweep of one panel (at 0, they move as one and only the last shows)

params.name: skew
params.note: Slant of the panels' edges

transitions.name: ColorPhase
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A crossfade in which each color channel changes at a different time

params.name: fromStep
params.note: When each channel (r, g, b, a) starts changing

params.name: toStep
params.note: When each channel (r, g, b, a) finishes changing

transitions.name: ColorWrap
transitions.author: Yoni Maltsman @friendlyspinach
transitions.description: Each color channel of the outgoing image is shifted and wraps around into psychedelic bands, while crossfading to the incoming image

params.name: r_strength
params.note: Shift of the red channel over the transition

params.name: g_strength
params.note: Shift of the green channel over the transition

params.name: b_strength
params.note: Shift of the blue channel over the transition

transitions.name: Comb
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame is cut into interleaved strips that slide in opposite directions, each pushing the outgoing image out and the incoming one in

params.name: strips
params.note: Number of strips

params.name: vertical
params.note: Cut the frame into columns that slide up and down instead

transitions.name: ComicPanels
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame splits into slanted comic-book panels with gutters and ink borders; one after another in reading order, each panel lifts off the page with a zoom kick and a drop shadow and punches over to the incoming image, then the gutters close up over the full incoming image

params.name: gutter
params.note: Width of the gutters between the panels, as a part of the frame's height

params.name: seed
params.note: Changes the layout of the panels

transitions.name: CrazyParametricFun
transitions.author: mandubian
transitions.description: The outgoing image is pulled along a parametric curve into a psychedelic swirl

transitions.name: Crosshatch
transitions.author: pthrasher
transitions.description: The incoming image appears through a crosshatch of lines spreading from the center

params.name: center
params.note: Point the lines spread from

transitions.name: CrossWarp
transitions.author: Eke Péter <peterekepeter@gmail.com>
transitions.description: The outgoing image zooms in while the incoming one zooms out into place, sweeping from right to left

transitions.name: CrossZoom
transitions.author: rectalogic
transitions.description: A crossfade through a strong zoom blur

params.name: strength
params.note: Blur strength

transitions.name: Crumple
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image crumples into a creased paper ball, shaded along its folds, which is then tossed away to reveal the incoming image

params.name: creases
params.note: Number of folds creasing the paper

params.name: size
params.note: Radius of the paper ball, relative to the image height

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the ball is tossed toward

transitions.name: Cube
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The two images are faces of a box that turns a quarter turn in perspective, the outgoing face darkening as it turns away, above a reflective floor

params.name: persp
params.note: Amount of perspective

params.name: unzoom
params.note: How far the camera pulls back mid-turn, as a part of the frame

params.name: reflection
params.note: Strength of the reflection

params.name: floating
params.note: Gap between the box and its reflection, as a percentage of the frame height

params.name: shading
params.note: How much the faces darken as they turn away, and the shadow on the floor

transitions.name: CurtainRise
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image rises like a theater festoon curtain: cords lift its hem into scalloped swags while the fabric gathers into shaded ruffles, and it is drawn up out of the frame over the incoming image

params.name: swags
params.note: Number of swags across a 16:9 frame (fewer in a portrait image)

params.name: sag
params.note: How low each swag droops between two cords, as a part of the frame's height

params.name: ruffles
params.note: Number of gathered ruffles in the fabric

params.name: shading
params.note: Depth of the shading on the ruffles and swags, and of the shadow under the hem

transitions.name: Curtains
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image parts in the middle like stage curtains, gathering into shaded folds as it is pulled to the sides

params.name: folds
params.note: Number of folds in each curtain (fewer in a portrait image)

params.name: shading
params.note: Depth of the shading on the folds

params.name: bunch
params.note: Width of each curtain once gathered, relative to the image width

params.name: sway
params.note: How much the bottom of the curtains lags behind the top

transitions.name: CurvedWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is pulled away by its middle: the wipe edge bulges into a smooth curve that leads the way, then flattens as it reaches the far side

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the edge moves toward

params.name: curvature
params.note: How far the middle of the edge leads its sides

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the edge

transitions.name: Cymatics
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is a layer of sand on a vibrating plate: it shivers, then runs together into the symmetric lines of a sound figure, uncovering the incoming image beneath as the plate, before the lines thin out and their grains hop off

params.name: modeX
params.note: Vibration mode across the plate: more nodal lines with a larger value

params.name: modeY
params.note: Vibration mode along the plate: more nodal lines with a larger value

params.name: lineWidth
params.note: Width of the lines of sand once gathered

transitions.name: DamBreak
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is a body of water held back by a dam on one side: the dam gives way, its top sinks toward the open side into a long rippling slope with a glossy, foaming surface that rushes out of the frame, stretching the picture along the flow, and the rest drains away, revealing the incoming image

params.name: gloss
params.note: Strength of the glossy highlight along the water surface

params.name: foam
params.note: Amount of foam on the surface, growing where the water runs fastest

params.name: leftward
params.note: Flow toward the left instead of the right

transitions.name: DefocusBlur
transitions.author: Sergey Kosarevsky
transitions.description: A crossfade through an out-of-focus blur

params.name: blurSize
params.note: Amount of blur

transitions.name: DiamondWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A soft-edged diamond grows from the center to reveal the incoming image

params.name: center
params.note: Center of the diamond

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the diamond's edge

transitions.name: DiffuseDissolve
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image diffuses into a shimmering, grainy haze, as if its pixels were scattered further and further from where they belong, and the incoming image condenses back out of the haze as they settle into place

params.name: radius
params.note: How far the pixels scatter at the peak, in frame heights

params.name: grainSize
params.note: Size of a grain, in frame heights

params.name: shimmer
params.note: How much the grains swirl around while they are scattered

transitions.name: Directional
transitions.author: Gaëtan Renaudeau
transitions.description: The incoming image pushes the outgoing one out in a given direction

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction of the movement

transitions.name: DirectionalEased
transitions.author: Max Plotnikov
transitions.description: Like Directional, with an eased movement

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction of the movement

transitions.name: DirectionalScaled
transitions.author: Thibaut Foussard
transitions.description: Like Directional, with both images scaled down while they slide

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction of the movement

transitions.name: DirectionalWarp
transitions.author: pschroen
transitions.description: A diagonal wipe with a warped, smeared edge

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the edge

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction of the wipe

transitions.name: DirectionalWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A straight wipe in any direction, diagonal and soft-edged by default; a smoothness of 0 gives a hard edge

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction of the wipe

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the edge

transitions.name: Disintegrate
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image crumbles into fine dust from one side, its grains blown away by the wind and fading out, revealing the incoming image underneath

params.name: particleSize
params.note: Size of the dust grains, in frame heights

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction in which the wind blows the dust

params.name: spread
params.note: How far the dust flies and scatters before it fades out

transitions.name: DisplacementMap
transitions.author: Travis Fischer
transitions.description: A crossfade in which a displacement map (an extra grayscale texture) warps both images

params.name: strength
params.note: Strength of the displacement

transitions.name: DitherDissolve
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image appears through a regular 8x8 ordered dither pattern, like a retro computer screen

params.name: dotSize
params.note: Size of a dither dot, relative to the height

transitions.name: DominoFall
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is cut into standing slats that topple backward like dominoes in a chain reaction across the frame, each one leaning onto the next and knocking it over, until they all lie flat and reveal the incoming image

params.name: count
params.note: Number of slats

params.name: reverse
params.note: The chain runs from right to left instead of left to right

params.name: knock
params.note: Part of a slat's fall after which it knocks the next one: lower runs the chain faster, with more slats falling at once

params.name: lean
params.note: How far each slat's top leans sideways onto the next one, as a part of a slat's width

params.name: perspective
params.note: Strength of the perspective

params.name: shading
params.note: How much the slats darken as they fall, and the shadows they cast

transitions.name: DoomMelt
transitions.author: Zeh Fernando
transitions.description: The outgoing image melts down in uneven columns, like the Doom screen wipe

transitions.name: Doorway
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image opens like double doors swinging toward the viewer, as the incoming one comes forward from the dark room behind, with a floor reflection

params.name: reflection
params.note: Strength of the floor reflection under the incoming image

params.name: perspective
params.note: Amount of perspective on the swinging doors

params.name: depth
params.note: How far back the incoming image starts (1: no distance)

transitions.name: Drape
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image hangs like a sheet of fabric that is let go at the top: it collapses into soft, uneven folds that hide one another as the cloth bunches up and slides down out of the frame, revealing the incoming image behind it

params.name: folds
params.note: Number of folds across the cloth (fewer in a portrait image)

params.name: depth
params.note: Depth of the folds and of their shading

params.name: sway
params.note: How much the cloth sways sideways as it falls

params.name: shadow
params.note: Strength of the soft shadow cast by the cloth on the incoming image

transitions.name: Dreamy
transitions.author: mikolalysenko
transitions.description: A crossfade with a gentle wavy distortion

transitions.name: DreamyZoom
transitions.author: Zeh Fernando
transitions.description: Zooms and rotates into a bright flash, then out to the incoming image

transitions.name: DuotoneFade
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is printed in two inks, shadows first, as a bold high-contrast duotone; the incoming image is printed over it in the same two inks, its dark tones landing before its highlights, then its own colors come back, highlights first

params.name: contrast
params.note: How hard the tones are pushed apart toward the two inks

params.name: grain
params.note: Amount of print grain in the inks and along the handoff

transitions.name: EchoSlide
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image slides away leaving a trail of discrete fading copies of itself, a stroboscopic echo, and the incoming image's echoes converge into place

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction in which the images slide

params.name: echoes
params.note: Number of echoes between the two images

params.name: trail
params.note: How long the echoes trail behind each image, as a part of the transition

params.name: decay
params.note: How fast the echoes of the outgoing image fade out into those of the incoming one

transitions.name: EdgeGlow
transitions.author: Woohyun Kim
transitions.description: Both images fade through black with their edges glowing

transitions.name: EqualizerWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image rises from the bottom of the frame in vertical bars that bounce up and down like an audio equalizer, lit in segments and each topped by a floating peak cap that falls back slowly, their average level climbing until they fill the frame

params.name: bars
params.note: Number of bars across the frame

params.name: bounce
params.note: How far the bars bounce above and below their average level, in frame heights

params.name: segments
params.note: Number of lit segments in a bar the height of the frame (0 for solid bars)

transitions.name: EyeBlink
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Curved eyelids close from the top and bottom over the outgoing image, which blurs and dims, then open on the incoming image as it comes back into focus, as if the viewer blinked

params.name: blur
params.note: How much the image blurs and dims while the eyes are closed

params.name: softness
params.note: Width of the soft shadow along the rim of the eyelids

params.name: blinks
params.note: Number of blinks: 1, or 2 for a quick double blink (the cut happens on the first one)

transitions.name: FacetedGlass
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame is seen through a pane of irregular cut-glass facets, each one showing its own shifted, zoomed and tilted view of the image, with bright beveled edges and thin dark seams; the facets turn to the incoming image one by one, then the glass flattens out and clears

params.name: facets
params.note: Number of facets across the height of the frame

params.name: refraction
params.note: How far each facet shifts its view of the image at the peak

params.name: bevel
params.note: Strength of the highlights and shadows along the beveled edges, and of the glint as each facet turns

params.name: seed
params.note: Random seed: another value gives other facets, turning in another order

transitions.name: Fade
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A linear crossfade between the two images

transitions.name: FadeColor
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A fade through a solid color, black by default

params.name: colorPhase
params.note: How long the color shows in the middle

transitions.name: FadeGrayscale
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A crossfade through grayscale

params.name: intensity
params.note: How long the grayscale phase lasts

transitions.name: Faint
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The viewer faints: the outgoing image splits into two swaying copies of itself and blurs while the edges of the view darken and close in, in two heartbeat throbs, down to a last pinpoint of light; the incoming image comes back blurred and doubled through a narrow tunnel, which widens again in throbs as the two copies drift together and lock

params.name: separation
params.note: How far apart the two copies drift at the peak, in frame heights

params.name: blur
params.note: How out of focus the view gets

transitions.name: FallOver
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image falls over backward, hinged on its bottom edge, revealing the incoming one behind it

params.name: perspective
params.note: Strength of the perspective

params.name: shading
params.note: How much the image darkens as it falls

transitions.name: FilmBurn
transitions.author: Anastasia Dunbar
transitions.description: Glowing film-burn light leaks wash over the image and reveal the incoming one

params.name: Seed
params.note: Random seed

transitions.name: FilmDissolve
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A cross-dissolve blended in linear light, as light adds up on film: the frame keeps its brightness all the way through and the highlights of each image shine through the other

params.name: overlap
params.note: Extra light where the two images overlap at mid-dissolve, softly rolled off so it never clips

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Easing of the dissolve: 0 is linear, 1 eases in and out

transitions.name: FilmLeader
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A clock hand sweeps the outgoing image away to reveal a scratched film countdown, with crosshair rings and big numbers counting down, each sweep wiping in the next one, and the last sweep reveals the incoming image in its wake

params.name: count
params.note: Number of numbers counted down before the incoming image

params.name: wear
params.note: Amount of film wear on the countdown: grain, scratches, dust and flicker

transitions.name: FilmStrip
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The picture slips like film in a projector gate: it shrinks to show the sprocket holes, the strip runs down with motion blur and a slight weave, then the incoming frame lands in place

params.name: frames
params.note: Number of frames that slip by

params.name: shrink
params.note: How much the picture shrinks during the slip, showing the film's edges

params.name: blur
params.note: Length of the motion blur at full speed

params.name: weave
params.note: Amount of horizontal weave and vertical jitter

transitions.name: Fisheye
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image bulges toward the viewer through a strong fisheye lens, then the incoming one flattens back into place

params.name: strength
params.note: Strength of the lens at its peak

transitions.name: FlameWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A wall of flames sweeps across the frame, scorching the outgoing image ahead of it and leaving the incoming image under a fading warm glow

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction in which the flames sweep across the frame

params.name: height
params.note: Height of the flames, as a fraction of the frame height

params.name: scorch
params.note: How much the outgoing image browns and chars ahead of the flames

params.name: glow
params.note: Strength of the warm glow left on the incoming image

transitions.name: FlashFade
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A crossfade that brightens toward a color in the middle

transitions.name: FlowDissolve
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Both images ride one current full of eddies: a sharp front sweeps across it and is wound into curls by every eddy it crosses, the outgoing image carried downstream ahead of it while the incoming one pours in behind, until the incoming image settles sharp

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction of the current

params.name: travel
params.note: How far the current carries the images (1: half the frame's short side)

params.name: swirl
params.note: Strength of the eddies compared with the drift (0: a straight front and drift)

params.name: seed
params.note: Random seed: another value gives other eddies

transitions.name: FlowerWipe
transitions.author: Fernando Kuteken
transitions.description: A flower shape with several petals grows to reveal the incoming image

params.name: segments
params.note: Number of petals

transitions.name: Flutter
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is let go and falls like a sheet of paper: it tips back and sinks while gliding from side to side, its leading edge dipping and rising at the end of each swing, until it drops out of the bottom of the frame, casting a shadow on the incoming image

params.name: swings
params.note: Number of side-to-side swings

params.name: sway
params.note: Width of each swing, in frame heights

params.name: shading
params.note: Shading of the sheet and darkness of its shadow

transitions.name: FlyEye
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image breaks into a fly's-eye grid of lenses with color separation

transitions.name: Fold
transitions.author: nwoeanhinnogaehr
transitions.description: The incoming image unfolds from the left while the outgoing one folds away to the right

transitions.name: FrostWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Ice crystals grow in from the edges of the frame with feathery, branching fronts, frosting the outgoing image white and blurry until it is covered, then thaw back out to the edges on the incoming image

params.name: spread
params.note: How far the crystal fingers reach ahead of the frost

params.name: scale
params.note: Size of the crystals: more, smaller ones with a larger value

params.name: blur
params.note: How much the frost blurs the image under it

transitions.name: Funnel
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image narrows into a curved funnel toward a point on the bottom edge and slides into it, its sides bending like a window minimized into a dock, revealing the incoming image behind it

params.name: target
params.note: Point of the bottom edge where the image disappears, from left (0) to right (1)

params.name: curvature
params.note: Shape of the funnel's sides: 0 straight, 1 bent into an S curve

params.name: shadow
params.note: Strength of the shading of the bent image and of the shadow it casts

transitions.name: Gallery
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera pulls back from the outgoing image to show it as a slide hanging in a row on a wall in perspective, the row glides along as each slide turns away from the center, and the camera moves back in on the incoming slide until it fills the frame

params.name: direction
params.note: Way the row moves: 1 brings the incoming slide in from the right, -1 from the left

params.name: tilt
params.note: How much the slides turn as they leave the center

params.name: gap
params.note: Space between two slides, in slide widths

params.name: zoom
params.note: How far the camera pulls back

params.name: reflection
params.note: Strength of the reflection of the slides on the floor

transitions.name: GeometricCollage
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image arrives cut into a geometric poster of quarter discs, half discs, triangles and their complements: piece after piece swings in around a corner of its cell, a flat plate of color just ahead of it, and lands flat with a soft paper shadow

params.name: cells
params.note: Number of cells along the short side of the frame, the long side gets as many as keep them about square

params.name: stagger
params.note: How spread out in time the pieces arrive: 0 swings them all in together, 1 lands them one after another

params.name: plates
params.note: Show a flat plate of color swinging in just ahead of each piece

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the shadows the pieces cast while they swing in

transitions.name: GlassRelief
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The shapes of the incoming image rise through the outgoing one as clear molded glass, bending it and catching the light along their outlines; then the glass fills with the incoming image's colors, brightest parts first, and melts flat into it

params.name: refraction
params.note: How strongly the glass bends the picture behind it

params.name: shine
params.note: Brightness of the light caught by the glass

params.name: light
params.note: Direction the light comes from when the relief is at its peak; it swings around it during the transition

transitions.name: GlintDissolve
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The bright points of the outgoing image sparkle into crisp four-point star glints that swell and twinkle up to the cut, then shrink back into the highlights of the incoming image, which stays sharp

params.name: size
params.note: Length of the longest rays of the glints at the peak, in frame heights

params.name: threshold
params.note: Brightness above which the image sparkles

params.name: intensity
params.note: Brightness of the glints

params.name: diagonals
params.note: Add a shorter, softer pair of diagonal rays to each glint

params.name: rotation
params.note: Angle of the cross, in degrees

params.name: rainbow
params.note: Rainbow fringes along the rays

transitions.name: GlitchBands
transitions.author: Yoni Maltsman @friendlyspinach
transitions.description: A crossfade with glitchy horizontal bands and color shifts

params.name: ampx
params.note: Horizontal amplitude of the glitch

params.name: ampy
params.note: Vertical amplitude of the glitch

transitions.name: GlitchDisplace
transitions.author: Matt DesLauriers
transitions.description: Blocks of the image are displaced in a glitch that flashes into the incoming image

transitions.name: GlitchFlicker
transitions.author: bread
transitions.description: A flickering glitch with RGB offset, ghosting and scanlines that flashes back to the outgoing image

transitions.name: GlitchMemories
transitions.author: Gunnar Roth
transitions.description: A crossfade with glitchy, color-shifted blocks

transitions.name: GlitterDissolve
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image becomes a shimmering field of tiny diamond sequins that flip over in 3D at random moments, each lifting and tilting on its own axis and flashing a glint of light, and land on the incoming image

params.name: tiles
params.note: Number of tiles stacked across the height of the frame

params.name: hexagons
params.note: Hexagonal tiles instead of diamonds

params.name: sparkle
params.note: Strength of the glints the tiles catch as they turn

params.name: seed
params.note: Changes the order and the axes of the flips (whole numbers)

transitions.name: GlowDissolve
transitions.author: hjm1fb
transitions.description: The incoming image spreads over the outgoing one with a hot, glowing edge

transitions.name: GooeyWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Soft, glossy blobs of liquid pop up over the outgoing image, swell and melt into each other, revealing the incoming image until they cover the whole frame

params.name: blobs
params.note: Number of blobs across the frame

params.name: smoothness
params.note: How smoothly neighbouring blobs melt into each other

transitions.name: GravityLens
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A black disk appears and grows, bending the outgoing image around it like a heavy mass bends light: the image is stretched into a bright ring at the disk's edge and swallowed until the frame is black, then the disk shrinks back, unbending the incoming image

params.name: strength
params.note: How strongly the light bends: radius of the lensed ring beyond the disk's edge, in disk radii

params.name: glow
params.note: Brightness of the lensed ring and of the thin ring of light hugging the disk's edge

transitions.name: GridFlip
transitions.author: TimDonselaar
transitions.description: The image splits into a grid of cards that lift apart and turn over in perspective one after another, each one showing its part of the incoming image on its back

params.name: size
params.note: Number of tiles (columns, rows)

params.name: pause
params.note: Part of the transition at the start and at the end during which the gaps between the tiles open and close

params.name: dividerWidth
params.note: Width of the gaps between the tiles, as a part of a tile's shorter side

params.name: randomness
params.note: How much the order of the flips is shuffled, from a diagonal wave across the grid to random

transitions.name: Halftone
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image breaks into printed halftone dots whose size follows its shades, the dots reshape into the incoming image, then merge back into it

params.name: dots
params.note: Number of dots across the shorter side

params.name: angle
params.note: Angle of the dot grid, in degrees

transitions.name: HeartWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A heart grows from the center with a little heartbeat to reveal the incoming image

params.name: center
params.note: Center of the heart

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the heart's edge

params.name: pulse
params.note: Strength of the heartbeat throb as the heart grows

params.name: glow
params.note: Strength of the glow (0 for a clean edge)

transitions.name: HeatHaze
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Shimmering heat waves rise through the frame, strongest at the bottom, making the outgoing image wobble like the air over hot asphalt; the incoming image shows through the haze and settles as it calms

params.name: strength
params.note: How far the haze bends the image, in frame heights (the strongest waves bend it about 1.5 times as far)

params.name: scale
params.note: Size of the heat waves: more, smaller ones with a larger value

params.name: speed
params.note: How fast the heat waves rise

transitions.name: HerringboneFold
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image collapses along a herringbone of zigzag creases like a folded map: in one motion it pleats in both directions at once, its facets lit and shaded in alternation, into a small compact packet that drops out of the frame, revealing the incoming image under its shadow

params.name: rows
params.note: Number of pleat rows across the height of the frame

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the shadow cast by the folding sheet

transitions.name: Hexagonalize
transitions.author: Fernando Kuteken
transitions.description: Both images turn into hexagons, crossfade, then sharpen again

params.name: horizontalHexagons
params.note: Number of hexagons across

transitions.name: HingedSquares
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image is cut into squares that turn in alternate directions while staying hinged at their corners, so the sheet opens into a checkerboard of diamonds showing the incoming image; those diamonds then turn back into place and close the sheet

params.name: cells
params.note: Number of squares across the height of the frame

params.name: shading
params.note: Strength of the bevel on the turning squares and of the soft shadow they cast into the gaps

params.name: zoom
params.note: How much the view zooms out to keep the opening sheet in frame (0: the sheet grows past the frame edges)

transitions.name: Hologram
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image turns into a flickering hologram (blue by default) with scanlines and jittering rows, breaks up, and the hologram resolves into the incoming image in full color

params.name: scanlines
params.note: Number of scanlines over the frame height

params.name: jitter
params.note: How far rows of the hologram jump sideways, relative to the frame width

params.name: flicker
params.note: Strength of the flicker and of the rows that drop out

transitions.name: Honeycomb
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image splits into hexagons that spin and shrink away in a wave from the center, uncovering the incoming image

params.name: size
params.note: Number of hexagons across the shorter side

transitions.name: HoneyDrip
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image sags like honey hanging from the top of the frame: its bottom gathers into one heavy amber drop that pulls the middle into a thinning glossy thread, the thread snaps, the drop falls out of the frame and the rest springs back up, revealing the incoming image

params.name: snap
params.note: When the thread snaps, as a part of the transition

params.name: gloss
params.note: Strength of the glossy shading, amber depth and refraction

transitions.name: HorizontalClose
transitions.author: martiniti
transitions.description: The incoming image closes in from the top and bottom edges toward the middle

transitions.name: HorizontalHold
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The picture loses its horizontal hold like an old TV: it shears into diagonal bands that slide sideways and wrap around, separated by a slanted blanking bar that carries the incoming image in, then the shear straightens, wobbles and locks

params.name: slips
params.note: Number of times the picture slips sideways before it locks

params.name: shear
params.note: How far the lines lag from top to bottom at the worst of the tearing, in picture widths

params.name: barWidth
params.note: Width of the blanking bar between the copies of the picture

transitions.name: HorizontalOpen
transitions.author: martiniti
transitions.description: The incoming image opens from a line in the middle toward the top and bottom edges

transitions.name: HsvFade
transitions.author: nwoeanhinnogaehr
transitions.description: A crossfade through the HSV color space that cycles through hues

transitions.name: Inchworm
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image crawls out of the frame like an inchworm: its back edge creeps forward and the picture humps up into a tall shaded arch, then its front edge reaches ahead and the arch flattens, two strides, uncovering the incoming image behind

params.name: arch
params.note: How tall the arch grows toward the viewer

transitions.name: InkBleed
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image spreads over the outgoing one like drops of ink in water, blooming from a few points with curling, wispy edges and a darker rim, until it fills the frame

params.name: drops
params.note: Number of ink drops

params.name: tendrils
params.note: How far the curling tendrils reach out of the blooms

params.name: rim
params.note: How dark the rim of ink at the front of the blooms is

params.name: seed
params.note: Random seed for the drop positions and the swirls

transitions.name: InsetWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A rectangle anchored in a corner, on an edge or in the center grows until the incoming image fills the frame, revealing it in place without scaling it; in reverse, the outgoing image shrinks into the rectangle

params.name: anchor
params.note: Where the rectangle grows from: (0, 0) bottom left, (1, 1) top right, (0.5, 0) middle of the bottom edge, (0.5, 0.5) center

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the rectangle's edge

params.name: borderWidth
params.note: Width of a border drawn around the rectangle, in frame heights (0: no border)

params.name: reverse
params.note: The outgoing image shrinks into the rectangle instead, toward the anchor

transitions.name: InsideCube
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera stands inside a cube: the outgoing image covers the wall in front of it and the view turns toward the next inner wall, so the outgoing image swings away in perspective as the incoming one turns into view, the walls darkening into the shaded inner corner between them

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the view turns toward, snapped to its main axis (left, right, up or down): the incoming image is on the wall on that side

params.name: fov
params.note: Field of view along the turn, in degrees: at 90 the camera stays at the center of the cube, a wider view makes the walls recede more

params.name: shading
params.note: How much the walls darken as they turn away, and the shadow in the inner corners of the cube

transitions.name: InterlaceWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image loads over the outgoing one like an interlaced picture on a slow connection: a first pass sweeps down drawing it in big blocky rows, then each new pass sweeps down again at twice the detail until the picture is sharp

params.name: rows
params.note: Number of rows of pixels of the picture being loaded, before its last pass draws it at full detail

params.name: passes
params.note: Number of passes, the first one drawing blocks 2^(passes - 1) rows tall

params.name: glow
params.note: Brightness of the freshly drawn rows behind each sweep

transitions.name: InvertedPageCurl
transitions.author: Hewlett-Packard
transitions.description: The outgoing image curls away like a page, revealing the incoming one

transitions.name: IrisFold
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Folded paper strips of the incoming image slide in one after another around a shrinking polygonal hole, each turned a little from the last so their creased edges spiral inward, until the hole closes on the center

params.name: sides
params.note: Number of sides of the hole

params.name: rounds
params.note: Number of rounds of strips around the hole

params.name: twist
params.note: How much each strip turns from the one before, in radians

params.name: shading
params.note: Strength of the creases' highlights and of the strips' shadows

transitions.name: Kaleidoscope
transitions.author: nwoeanhinnogaehr
transitions.description: A crossfade through a spinning kaleidoscope

transitions.name: KeyholeWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A keyhole grows steadily from the center until the incoming image fills the frame, its bevelled rim and inner shadow making it read as a hole cut in a plate

params.name: center
params.note: Center of the keyhole

params.name: rim
params.note: Strength of the bevelled rim around the keyhole and the shadow inside it (0 for a clean cut)

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the keyhole's edge

transitions.name: Knead
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is kneaded like dough: its two halves squeeze and slide past each other into two rows, again and again, until the picture is drawn out into thin layers; the layers of the incoming image are pressed in between them, then the incoming image is unkneaded back into one picture

params.name: kneads
params.note: Number of kneads on each side (each one stacks the picture into twice as many layers)

params.name: shadow
params.note: Depth of the shading on the layers and of the shadow the sliding half casts

transitions.name: LayoutGrid
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame splits into an asymmetric magazine grid as paper gutters open between the panels; panel after panel in reading order, the incoming image pushes the outgoing one out of its panel from a different side, a colored accent band between them, then the gutters close over the full incoming image

params.name: gutter
params.note: Width of the gutters at their widest, as a part of the frame's shorter side

params.name: overlap
params.note: How much the panels' pushes overlap in time (0 pushes them one strictly after another, 0.9 almost all together)

params.name: band
params.note: Length of the accent band between the two images, as a part of the panel's length along its push

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the soft shadows the panels cast on the paper and the incoming image casts on the band

transitions.name: LeafWipe
transitions.author: @Flexi23
transitions.description: A leaf shape grows from the center to reveal the incoming image

transitions.name: LedWall
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The picture zooms into a giant LED screen of round glowing diodes on a dark panel; a refresh wave sweeps across it, each diode flicking with a bright pop as it switches to the incoming image, then the diodes melt back into the plain picture

params.name: cells
params.note: Number of diodes across the shorter side

params.name: glow
params.note: Strength of the glow bleeding from the diodes into the dark panel

params.name: flash
params.note: Brightness of the flash of each diode as it switches

params.name: zoom
params.note: How much the picture zooms in while it is a screen

params.name: triads
params.note: Each diode is made of red, green and blue sub-diodes

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction in which the refresh wave sweeps across the screen

transitions.name: LeftRight
transitions.author: zhmy
transitions.description: The outgoing image shrinks away to the left while the incoming one slides in from the right

transitions.name: LensFlare
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A bright light sweeps across the frame and flares the lens: a long thin horizontal streak, a glowing core and a trail of colored ghost reflections; at its peak the incoming image spreads out from the light under its glare

params.name: angle
params.note: Angle of the path of the light, in degrees (0 sweeps from left to right)

params.name: height
params.note: How far above the center of the frame the light passes

params.name: intensity
params.note: Brightness of the flare

transitions.name: LensPush
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image pushes the outgoing one out of frame as if seen through a wide-angle lens: the frame bulges and bends the seam while the images speed past, with motion blur, color fringes toward the edges and a light vignette, then flattens back as the push lands

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction in which the images move, snapped to the nearest of the 8 horizontal, vertical and diagonal directions

params.name: strength
params.note: Strength of the lens bulge at the peak

params.name: fringe
params.note: Spread of the color fringes toward the edges

params.name: blur
params.note: Length of the motion blur at full speed

transitions.name: LensWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A round glass lens grows from a point over the outgoing image, casting a soft shadow on it, and shows the incoming image magnified through it, with a bright bevelled rim and faint color fringes; as the lens fills the frame the magnification relaxes until the incoming image lies flat

params.name: center
params.note: Point the lens grows from

params.name: strength
params.note: How strongly the lens magnifies the middle of the incoming image at the start

params.name: shading
params.note: Strength of the rim's light and shade and of the shadow the lens casts (0 for a clean cut)

transitions.name: LightningFlash
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Forked lightning bolts crack down from the top of the frame, the screen flashes white in a few stuttering strobes, and the incoming image appears lit by the last flickers as they fade out

params.name: bolts
params.note: Number of bolts: the main one strikes the ground, the others fork out higher in the sky

params.name: strike
params.note: Where the main bolt strikes, from the left (0) to the right (1) of the frame

params.name: seed
params.note: Changes the shape of the bolts

params.name: glow
params.note: Size and brightness of the glow around the bolts

params.name: flashes
params.note: Number of strobes; the images switch during the brightest one

transitions.name: LightRays
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Shafts of light burst from the highlights of the outgoing image and stream outward from a slowly drifting center; at their peak the incoming image takes over and its own rays shrink back into its highlights

params.name: center
params.note: Point the rays stream away from, at the middle of the transition

params.name: drift
params.note: How far the center drifts during the transition, from left to right

params.name: reach
params.note: Length of the rays at the peak, as a fraction of their distance to the center

params.name: threshold
params.note: Brightness above which the image casts rays

params.name: intensity
params.note: Brightness of the rays

transitions.name: LightStreaks
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The highlights of the outgoing image flare into long horizontal (or vertical) lens streaks while it smears with motion blur; at the peak the incoming image takes over and its streaks shrink back into its highlights as it sharpens

params.name: reach
params.note: Length of the streaks at the peak, in frame widths

params.name: threshold
params.note: Brightness above which the image flares

params.name: intensity
params.note: Brightness of the streaks

params.name: blur
params.note: Length of the motion blur at the peak

params.name: vertical
params.note: Streak and smear vertically instead

transitions.name: LightWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A band of intense light sweeps across the frame like a glint on glass, blooming the highlights of both images, and leaves the incoming image behind it

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the band of light moves toward

params.name: width
params.note: Width of the bright core of the band, in frame heights

params.name: intensity
params.note: Brightness of the light

transitions.name: LiquidFill
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image rises over the outgoing one like liquid filling a glass, its surface sloshing in waves, lit by a bright meniscus line, bending the image just below it, with a few bubbles rising through it

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the liquid rises toward

params.name: amplitude
params.note: Height of the waves on the surface, in frame heights

params.name: waves
params.note: Number of waves across the frame

params.name: refraction
params.note: How much the incoming image is bent just below the surface

params.name: bubbles
params.note: How many bubbles rise through the liquid

transitions.name: LissajousTiles
transitions.author: Boundless <info@boundless-beta.com>
transitions.description: The image breaks into a grid of tiles that swirl along Lissajous curves, in a Scanimate style, and flip one by one to the incoming image before settling back

params.name: speed
params.note: Speed of the tiles along their curves

params.name: freq
params.note: Number of loops of the curve, horizontally and vertically

params.name: offset
params.note: Extra vertical speed, which bends the curve

params.name: zoom
params.note: Size of the curve, relative to the image

params.name: fade
params.note: Spread of the tile-by-tile switch to the incoming image

transitions.name: LumaWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A wipe that follows the brightness of a grayscale mask (the luma texture)

transitions.name: LuminanceMelt
transitions.author: 0gust1
transitions.description: The outgoing image melts away in noisy vertical streaks, depending on its brightness

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction of the melt (false: up, true: down)

params.name: l_threshold
params.note: Luminance threshold

params.name: above
params.note: Melt the parts above the threshold instead of below

transitions.name: MarblingDissolve
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image floats onto the outgoing one in thin bands of ink that a rake drags into zigzags and a fine comb pulls into feathers, like marbled paper; the bands widen until they cover the frame and the combs pull back out, leaving the incoming image clean

params.name: tines
params.note: Number of teeth of the rake dragged up and down, along the longer side of the frame

params.name: pull
params.note: How far the teeth of the rake drag the picture, in frame heights (the fine comb drags it 0.6 times as far)

params.name: bands
params.note: Number of bands of ink across the frame

params.name: veins
params.note: How dark the thin lines of ink between the two images are

transitions.name: MicroBrickCascade
transitions.author: Gilad Levi
transitions.description: The outgoing image fractures into a dense wall of tiny square tiles. A diagonal cascade releases the tiles in staggered waves, causing them to fall and drift aside while the incoming image is revealed beneath.

params.name: tileSize
params.note: Size of each square tile relative to frame height

params.name: fall
params.note: Downward falling strength of released tiles

params.name: drift
params.note: Sideways drift amount while tiles fall

params.name: diagonal
params.note: How diagonal the release wave is

params.name: stagger
params.note: Random stagger amount between neighboring tiles

params.name: softness
params.note: Softness of tile disappearance

params.name: glow
params.note: Brightness of the moving tile edge highlight

transitions.name: MoireWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Two sets of fine concentric rings, centered on two points that drift toward each other, overlay the image and interfere into a shifting moire of wide bands; the bands open onto the incoming image and widen until it fills the frame, while the thin dark and light ring lines fade away

params.name: density
params.note: Number of rings per frame height in each set

params.name: bands
params.note: How many moire bands the rings make at the start; they get fewer and wider as the centers come together

params.name: drift
params.note: How far the two centers turn around each other, in turns

params.name: lines
params.note: Strength of the ring lines drawn over the image

transitions.name: Morph
transitions.author: paniq
transitions.description: A crossfade in which each image is displaced by the other's colors, like a morph

params.name: strength
params.note: Strength of the displacement

transitions.name: Mosaic
transitions.author: Xaychru
transitions.description: The view pans across a mosaic of rotated tiles from both images and settles on the incoming one

transitions.name: MultiplyBlend
transitions.author: Fernando Kuteken
transitions.description: A crossfade through the multiplied blend of both images

transitions.name: Nightfall
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Night crosses the frame like the shadow line of a turning globe: a warm dusk glows along its curved edge and dims the outgoing image into blue moonlight that keeps it legible, then a second curved edge glows rose as dawn and brings up the daylight on the incoming image

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the night travels toward

params.name: night
params.note: Width of the night between dusk and dawn, in frame heights

params.name: darkness
params.note: How dark the night gets

params.name: bow
params.note: Bow of the dusk and dawn lines, as seen on a globe

transitions.name: NoiseDissolve
transitions.author: towrabbit
transitions.description: The incoming image appears pixel by pixel in random noise

transitions.name: OutlineCrumble
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Thin cracks run through the outgoing image along its own outlines, then the pieces they cut sag loose and fall away one after another from the top, tumbling and shrinking into the incoming image beneath

params.name: cells
params.note: Pieces across the height of the frame

params.name: follow
params.note: How closely the cracks follow the outlines of the picture

transitions.name: OutlineFill
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image is colored in from its own outlines: they appear first as thin lines over the outgoing image, then its colors spread out from every outline with a soft, darker wet edge, and the widest plain areas fill in last

params.name: reach
params.note: How far the color spreads from the outlines, in frame heights: areas farther from any outline fill in at the end

params.name: threshold
params.note: Contrast needed around a pixel before the color reaches it: lower also spreads from faint edges

transitions.name: OutlineTear
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image tears across along its own strongest outline, such as a horizon, showing white paper fibers; the torn top is pulled up and the bottom drops down, casting soft shadows on the incoming image

params.name: rim
params.note: Width of the white torn edge, relative to the image height

params.name: roughness
params.note: How ragged the tear is around the outline, relative to the image height

transitions.name: Overexposure
transitions.author: Ben Zhang
transitions.description: A crossfade through a washed-out, overexposed white

params.name: strength
params.note: Amount of overexposure

transitions.name: PaintDissolve
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image is painted over the outgoing one in layers of brush strokes, broad flat strokes of its colors first, then smaller and smaller ones, until the last fine strokes lay down its full detail

params.name: brushSize
params.note: Length of the broadest brush strokes, in frame heights

params.name: angle
params.note: Main direction of the brush strokes, in degrees

params.name: crossing
params.note: How much the direction of the strokes changes from one layer to the next

params.name: impasto
params.note: How thick the paint looks: relief and shine of the brush marks while it is wet

transitions.name: PaperFold
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is a sheet of paper that folds in half in 3D along a vertical crease, then in half again along a horizontal one, its lit and shaded faces turning to show the back of the paper, and the small folded packet flies off the frame, leaving its shadow on the incoming image underneath

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the folded packet flies off toward

params.name: tilt
params.note: How much the sheet tilts and recedes while it folds, so that the folds are seen in 3D

params.name: shading
params.note: How much the faces darken as they turn away from the light, and the shadows they cast

transitions.name: PaperLayers
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image is rebuilt as a stack of cut paper sheets, one per band of brightness: from the darkest to the lightest, each sheet slides in lifted above the stack, drops into place with a soft shadow on the sheets below, then the paper flattens into the photo

params.name: layers
params.note: Number of paper sheets, one per band of brightness of the incoming image

params.name: colorful
params.note: How much of the incoming image's colors the paper takes: 0 is plain paper in shades of the paper color

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the shadows the sheets cast on the ones below

transitions.name: PaperTear
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image tears in two along a ragged line, and the halves are pulled apart to reveal the incoming one

params.name: roughness
params.note: How far the tear wanders from the middle, relative to the image height

params.name: tilt
params.note: How much the top of each half leans away first, so that the tear opens from the top

params.name: rim
params.note: Width of the white torn edge, relative to the image height

transitions.name: ParallaxPush
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera tracks sideways past a dark, out-of-focus pillar standing close to the lens: the pillar rushes across the frame while the images far behind it drift slowly the same way with a slight push in, and the cut to the incoming image happens hidden behind it

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction in which everything moves, snapped to its main axis (left, right, up or down)

params.name: parallax
params.note: How far each image drifts behind the pillar, as a part of the frame

params.name: width
params.note: Width of the pillar, as a part of the shorter side of the frame

params.name: blur
params.note: How out of focus the pillar is, and how much it blurs as it rushes past

transitions.name: PerlinDissolve
transitions.author: Rich Harris
transitions.description: The incoming image appears through blobs of Perlin noise

params.name: scale
params.note: Scale of the noise; higher values make smaller blobs

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the blob edges

params.name: seed
params.note: Random seed

transitions.name: PhotoDevelop
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image washes out to a blank cream card, then the incoming image develops on it like an instant photo: shadows first, faint and tinted, then its contrast and colors come up and it settles

params.name: wash
params.note: How long the outgoing image takes to wash out (from 10% to 70% of the transition)

params.name: tint
params.note: Strength of the cyan and magenta cast while the image develops

transitions.name: PinchLift
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is pinched at one point like a handkerchief: its sides drop and swing in under the pinch, gathering into hanging pleats, then it is let go and falls down out of the frame, revealing the incoming image behind its shadow

params.name: pleats
params.note: Number of pleats hanging from the pinch

params.name: depth
params.note: Depth of the pleats and of their shading

params.name: swing
params.note: How far the hanging cloth swings before it settles

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the soft shadow cast on the incoming image

transitions.name: Pinwheel
transitions.author: Mr Speaker
transitions.description: A spinning pinwheel reveals the incoming image

params.name: speed
params.note: Rotation speed

transitions.name: Pixelize
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Both images pixelate, crossfade, then sharpen again

params.name: squaresMin
params.note: Number of squares at the strongest pixelation

params.name: steps
params.note: Number of pixelation steps; 0 for a continuous effect

transitions.name: PixelStretch
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A line sweeps across the frame and drags the outgoing image's pixels behind it as long streaks, which shorten as it goes and reveal the incoming image

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction in which the line sweeps

params.name: stretch
params.note: Length of the streaks at the middle of the sweep, as a part of the frame

params.name: chroma
params.note: Amount of RGB split along the streaks

params.name: softness
params.note: Softness of the line and of the streaks' ends, as a part of the frame

params.name: jitter
params.note: How much the streaks jitter, each row at its own length

transitions.name: PlasmaDissolve
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A flowing plasma of sine waves, as in the old demos, draws moving bands through which the incoming image spreads like tendrils, with a glowing edge

params.name: scale
params.note: Size of the plasma: higher values make more, thinner bands

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the band edges

params.name: flow
params.note: How much the plasma flows during the transition (at most 1, so a revealed area never goes back)

params.name: edgeStrength
params.note: Strength of the glow along the edges

transitions.name: PlusWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A plus-shaped cross grows from the center and widens its arms until the incoming image fills the frame

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the cross's edge

params.name: reverse
params.note: Close four corner rectangles in toward the middle instead

transitions.name: PolkaDotsCurtain
transitions.author: bobylito
transitions.description: The incoming image appears through growing polka dots

params.name: dots
params.note: Number of dots across the image

transitions.name: PopIn
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image pops in as a rounded card over the outgoing one, with an elastic overshoot: too big, a bit small, then it settles into the full frame as its corners square off

params.name: center
params.note: Point of the frame the incoming image pops from

params.name: bounce
params.note: How far the card overshoots (too big, then a bit small) before it settles

params.name: corner
params.note: Corner radius of the card while it pops, relative to its shorter side

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the drop shadow the card casts on the outgoing image

transitions.name: PosterPaste
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image is pasted over the outgoing one as a poster, sheet after sheet: each wet sheet drops onto the wall hanging loose from its top edge with a soft shadow, then a brush smooths it on from top to bottom, leaving wrinkles and air bubbles that flatten out and seams that fade as the paste dries

params.name: sheets
params.note: Number of poster sheets pasted side by side, from left to right

params.name: wrinkles
params.note: How wrinkled, blistered and billowing the wet paper is before the brush smooths it flat

transitions.name: PowerKaleido
transitions.author: Boundless
transitions.description: The image folds into an animated kaleidoscope before revealing the incoming one

transitions.name: Prisms
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame is cut into 3D prisms that turn in a cascade, like a rotating billboard, from the outgoing image on one face to the incoming one on the next

params.name: slats
params.note: Number of prisms

params.name: stagger
params.note: Delay of the last prism's turn, as a part of the transition

params.name: perspective
params.note: Amount of perspective

params.name: shading
params.note: How much the faces darken as they turn away

params.name: horizontal
params.note: Cut the frame into horizontal prisms instead

transitions.name: ProjectorThrow
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The lights go down on the outgoing image and a projector throws the incoming one onto it: a small, blurred, keystoned picture of light lands on the scene, tinted by the colors it falls on, then grows, comes into focus and squares up until it fills the frame as the scene beneath it fades away

params.name: darkness
params.note: How dark the outgoing image gets once the lights go down

params.name: keystone
params.note: How much wider the top of the projected picture is than its bottom when it lands

params.name: blur
params.note: How out of focus the projected picture is when it lands, in frame heights

transitions.name: Puzzle
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image is cut into jigsaw puzzle pieces that lift one after another and fall away, revealing the incoming image

params.name: pieces
params.note: Number of pieces across the shorter side

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the shadows of the lifted pieces

transitions.name: PuzzleCube
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame becomes the face of a twisty cube puzzle: dark gaps open between its cubies, then whole columns and rows of cubies turn a quarter turn around the cube one after another in 3D, each bringing the incoming image from the cube's side to the front, until the gaps close on the incoming image

params.name: size
