params.note: Number of cubies along each side of the face

params.name: gap
params.note: Width of the gaps between the cubies, as a part of the frame's height

params.name: shading
params.note: How much the turning sides darken away from the light, and the shadows inside the cube

transitions.name: QuadtreeBlocks
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image breaks into a quadtree of flat color blocks, small where it is detailed and large where it is plain; the blocks merge into a few big squares that change color one by one, then split again, finer and finer, into the incoming image

params.name: tolerance
params.note: How different the colors inside a block may be before it splits (larger gives bigger blocks)

params.name: seams
params.note: Darkness of the thin seams between the blocks

transitions.name: QuadTurn
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image is cut into square tiles that turn in blocks of four like little turntables, a quarter turn at a time on two staggered grids, lifting over their neighbours and scrambling the outgoing image; a wave flips the tiles over to the incoming image, then the blocks turn back the same way until every tile is home

params.name: tiles
params.note: Number of tiles along the short side of the frame

params.name: stagger
params.note: Delay between the first and the last block of each turn, as a part of the turn

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the shadows cast by the lifted tiles

transitions.name: RadialWipe
transitions.author: Xaychru
transitions.description: A radial wipe that sweeps around the center like a clock hand

transitions.name: RandomSquares
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image appears in random squares

params.name: size
params.note: Number of squares (columns, rows)

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of each square's switch

transitions.name: Reassemble
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image cracks into irregular shards that burst apart toward the viewer, each one turning over in 3D at its own moment, then fly back together and lock into place as the incoming image carried on their backs

params.name: rows
params.note: Number of rows of shards

params.name: depth
params.note: How far the shards come toward the viewer

params.name: spread
params.note: How far the shards spread apart, as a part of their distance from the center

transitions.name: RectangleCover
transitions.author: martiniti
transitions.description: A rectangle grows from the center to cover the outgoing image, then shrinks to reveal the incoming one

transitions.name: RectangleIris
transitions.author: martiniti
transitions.description: The outgoing image shrinks into a small rectangle over a background color, then the incoming one grows from it

transitions.name: ReededGlass
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A wide pane of reeded glass slides across the frame: behind its rounded vertical ribs the picture breaks into narrow, flipped and squeezed slices with faint color fringes, the outgoing image on the far side of the pane and the incoming one behind it, and where the pane has passed the incoming image is left clear

params.name: paneWidth
params.note: Width of the pane, in frame widths

params.name: ribs
params.note: Number of ribs across the frame width

params.name: strength
params.note: How strongly each rib flips and squeezes the slice behind it

params.name: shine
params.note: Strength of the highlights, seams and shadow of the glass

transitions.name: Refraction
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame is seen through flowing liquid glass that bends the outgoing image more and more, with rainbow fringes, flares up as the incoming image takes over, then calms down and clears

params.name: strength
params.note: How far the glass bends the image at the peak

params.name: scale
params.note: Size of the flowing waves: higher makes smaller waves

params.name: dispersion
params.note: Spread of the rainbow fringes

params.name: brightness
params.note: Brightness of the flare at the peak

transitions.name: Revolve
transitions.author: bread
transitions.description: The outgoing image swirls and zooms with motion blur into the incoming one

params.name: center
params.note: Center of the swirl

transitions.name: RibbonTwist
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image twists like a ribbon around its horizontal center line, the twist travelling smoothly across its width, the outgoing image on its front and the incoming one on its back

params.name: spread
params.note: Length of the twisted section, as a part of the frame's width

params.name: perspective
params.note: Amount of perspective: the edge turning toward the viewer grows

params.name: shading
params.note: How much the ribbon darkens as it turns away

params.name: vertical
params.note: Twist around the vertical center line instead, travelling from top to bottom

transitions.name: RingSpin
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame is cut into concentric rings that spin like the dials of a combination lock, in alternating directions and blurred with speed, one after another from the center outward; each ring overshoots a little and locks into place on the incoming image

params.name: rings
params.note: Number of rings, from the center to the farthest corner

params.name: square
params.note: Square rings, like nested frames, instead of round ones

params.name: turns
params.note: Full turns made by each ring

params.name: stagger
params.note: Delay between the first ring and the last one, as a part of the transition

params.name: blur
params.note: Amount of angular motion blur while the rings spin fast

params.name: settle
params.note: Size of the overshoot when a ring locks

transitions.name: RingsWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Concentric rings ripple out from the center and, one after another, each sweeps around like a clock hand in the opposite direction of its neighbors to reveal the incoming image, or fills across its width, with optional colored borders between the rings

params.name: count
params.note: Number of rings, from the center to the farthest corner

params.name: center
params.note: Center of the rings, in texture coordinates

params.name: stagger
params.note: Delay between the starts of two rings: 0 moves them all together, 1 starts each one when the previous one is done

params.name: radial
params.note: Each ring fills across its width, outward and inward in turn, instead of sweeping around

params.name: borderWidth
params.note: Width of the borders between the rings while they move, in frame heights (0 disables them)

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the edges

transitions.name: Ripple
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Ripples spread from the center while crossfading

params.name: amplitude
params.note: Frequency of the ripples

params.name: speed
params.note: Speed of the ripples

transitions.name: Rolls
transitions.author: Mark Craig
transitions.description: The outgoing image rolls away around a corner, revealing the incoming one

params.name: type
params.note: Corner to roll around

params.name: RotDown
params.note: Roll the outgoing image down instead of up

transitions.name: RotateScaleFade
transitions.author: Fernando Kuteken
transitions.description: The outgoing image spins and zooms while fading to the incoming one, over a background color

params.name: center
params.note: Center of the rotation

params.name: rotations
params.note: Number of turns

params.name: scale
params.note: Maximum zoom

transitions.name: RotateScaleVanish
transitions.author: Mark Craig
transitions.description: The outgoing image spins and shrinks away over the incoming one

params.name: FadeInSecond
params.note: Fade in the incoming image

params.name: ReverseEffect
params.note: Run the effect in reverse

params.name: ReverseRotation
params.note: Rotate the other way

transitions.name: SawtoothWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A wipe whose edge is a row of sharp, regular triangular teeth sweeps across the frame, or two toothed edges that start interlocked part from the middle like jaws opening

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the toothed edge moves toward (with jaws, the axis along which the two edges part)

params.name: teeth
params.note: Number of teeth along the edge

params.name: depth
params.note: Length of the teeth, relative to their width

params.name: jaws
params.note: Two toothed edges part from the middle instead of one sweeping across

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the edge

transitions.name: ScreenPrintWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A squeegee sweeps back and forth across the frame four times, pushing a bead of ink ahead of its blade and printing the incoming image one halftone ink at a time, yellow, magenta, cyan then black, slightly out of register and streaky, until the layers settle into register and the dots melt into the full picture

params.name: dots
params.note: Number of halftone dots across the frame height: more makes a finer screen, which can shimmer at small sizes

params.name: misregistration
params.note: How far the ink layers are printed out of register, in frame heights

params.name: grit
params.note: Amount of ink texture: squeegee streaks and ink-starved specks

transitions.name: Shatter
transitions.author: lbl
transitions.description: The outgoing image cracks like a pane of glass from an impact point, then its shards break loose from the impact outward, tumbling in 3D and falling away with gravity to reveal the incoming image behind

params.name: center
params.note: Impact point where the cracks start, from (0, 0) at the bottom left to (1, 1) at the top right

params.name: shards
params.note: Approximate number of rows of shards across the height of the frame

params.name: gravity
params.note: Strength of the gravity: the shards fall faster, and break loose over a longer time

params.name: seed
params.note: Random seed: another value gives other shards, tumbling another way

transitions.name: Shockwave
transitions.author: Gilad Levi, github @Giladx
transitions.description: A diagonal shockwave breaks the outgoing image into tiny falling glass tiles. Each tile slips away with a brief chromatic split and neon edge glow, revealing the incoming image beneath it.

params.name: tileSize
params.note: Size of each square tile relative to slide height

params.name: scatter
params.note: How far the tiles slide and fall

params.name: diagonal
params.note: 0 is a horizontal sweep; 1 is a strongly diagonal sweep

params.name: prism
params.note: Amount of red/blue optical separation at the moving edges

params.name: glow
params.note: Brightness of the colored edges around moving tiles

transitions.name: ShoreWash
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A thin sheet of water runs up over the outgoing image like the last of a wave on a beach, its lobed front edged with bubbly foam; it slows, stops just past the far edge and drains back, leaving the incoming image wet and glossy as it dries

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the water runs up toward

params.name: foam
params.note: Amount of foam on the front and left behind

params.name: refraction
params.note: How much the sheet of water bends the image under it

transitions.name: Shred
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is cut into paper strips that drop away at uneven speeds, tilting as they fall, revealing the incoming image

params.name: strips
params.note: Number of strips

params.name: stagger
params.note: Spread of the strips' start times, as a part of the transition

params.name: tilt
params.note: Largest tilt of a falling strip, in radians

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the strips' cut edges and of their shadow

transitions.name: ShutterWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A camera's focal-plane shutter fires across the frame, seen through the camera's gate: thin metal blades fan down from a tight stack above it until they overlap over the whole frame, then keep running down and stack below it, uncovering the incoming image from the top

params.name: blades
params.note: Number of metal blades

params.name: tilt
params.note: How much the blades tilt on their arms while they travel

params.name: gate
params.note: Width of the camera's gate framing the image while the shutter fires, in frame heights

transitions.name: SimpleFlip
transitions.author: nwoeanhinnogaehr
transitions.description: The outgoing image flips around the vertical axis into the incoming one

transitions.name: SimpleZoom
transitions.author: 0gust1
transitions.description: Zooms into the outgoing image, then fades to the incoming one

params.name: zoom_quickness
params.note: Part of the transition spent zooming

transitions.name: SimpleZoomOut
transitions.author: Tianshuo
transitions.description: The incoming image zooms out into place while fading in

params.name: zoom_quickness
params.note: Part of the transition spent zooming

params.name: fade
params.note: Fade instead of cutting to the incoming image

transitions.name: SketchDissolve
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image fades back to blank paper while the incoming one is drawn on it in pencil, outlines first and then hatching in the shadows, before its shading and colors fill in until the picture is complete

params.name: lineWidth
params.note: Thickness of the pencil outlines, in thousandths of the frame height

params.name: edges
params.note: How many outlines are drawn: higher also traces the fainter edges of the picture

params.name: hatching
params.note: Amount of diagonal hatching drawn in the shadows

transitions.name: SlashSplit
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A bright blade stroke slashes diagonally across the outgoing image with a flash, then the two cut halves slip along the cut in opposite directions and fly off the frame, casting soft shadows on the incoming image beneath

params.name: angle
params.note: Angle of the cut against the horizontal, in degrees

params.name: separation
params.note: How far the halves move apart across the cut as they slide, relative to the image height

transitions.name: SlideAwayRight
transitions.author: lizhongjian
transitions.description: The outgoing image slides to the right, uncovering a crossfade to the incoming one

transitions.name: SlideProjector
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A slide projector changes slides: the outgoing picture is jerked up out of the frame, blurring as it leaves the focal plane, the bare lamp flickers on the screen for an instant, then the incoming picture drops in from the top, bounces and hunts for focus before it sharpens

params.name: bounce
params.note: How high the incoming slide bounces when it lands in the gate

params.name: defocus
params.note: How out of focus the slides get while they move

params.name: flicker
params.note: How much the lamp flickers during the change

transitions.name: Slides
transitions.author: Mark Craig
transitions.description: The outgoing image slides out, or the incoming one slides in, toward an edge, a corner or the center

params.name: In
params.note: Slide the incoming image in instead of the outgoing one out

transitions.name: SlitStretch
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is a sheet cut with rows of staggered slits that is pulled from both ends: it lengthens, the slits open into diamonds and the strands between them twist and thin out like expanded metal until only the incoming image is left behind

params.name: size
params.note: Length of a slit and its bridge, relative to the image height

params.name: stretch
params.note: How much the sheet lengthens as it is pulled

params.name: shading
params.note: Strength of the shading of the twisting strands and of their shadow

params.name: neck
params.note: How much the sheet narrows at its waist as it is pulled

params.name: horizontal
params.note: Pull the sheet sideways instead, with vertical slits

transitions.name: SlotReels
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame is cut into vertical reels that spin downward like drums, motion-blurred with speed, carrying the outgoing image then the incoming one, and stop one after another from left to right with a small mechanical bounce

params.name: reels
params.note: Number of reels

params.name: blur
params.note: Amount of vertical motion blur while the reels spin fast

params.name: stagger
params.note: Delay between the first and the last reel's stop, as a part of the transition

params.name: bounce
params.note: Size of the bounce when a reel stops

transitions.name: SmokeDissolve
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Billowing smoke drifts in across the outgoing image, with lit tops, darker folds and wispy edges, and thickens until it covers the frame; as it thins out and drifts away, the incoming image shows through

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the smoke drifts toward (it comes in from the opposite side); its length is how far it drifts, in frame heights

params.name: scale
params.note: Size of the billows: more, smaller ones with a larger value

params.name: spread
params.note: How much the smoke rolls in from one side rather than everywhere at once

params.name: softness
params.note: Softness of the smoke: wispier, more see-through edges with a larger value

transitions.name: SnakeBlockWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Blocks switch to the incoming image one at a time, row after row from the top (or column after column from the left), each line running the opposite way to the one before, like a snake winding across the frame

params.name: grid
params.note: Number of blocks (columns, rows)

params.name: vertical
params.note: Wind down the columns instead of along the rows

params.name: smoothness
params.note: How long each block takes to fade in, in turns of one block (0 switches it at once)

transitions.name: Snapshot
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A camera flash freezes the outgoing image into a printed photo with a white border, which shrinks, tilts and drops out of the frame, revealing the incoming image behind it

params.name: tilt
params.note: How much the photo turns as it drops

params.name: border
params.note: Width of the photo's border, relative to the frame height

params.name: flash
params.note: Strength of the camera flash

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the soft shadow the photo casts on the incoming image

transitions.name: SoapDrop
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A drop of soap touches the outgoing image, which floats on water like a skin: the skin rushes away from the drop and piles up into a glossy, wrinkled rim that is shoved out of the frame, leaving the incoming image under clear, rippling water

params.name: center
params.note: Where the drop touches the skin

params.name: crumple
params.note: How much the piled-up skin wrinkles

transitions.name: SpeedLines
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Comic-style speed lines shoot in from the edges of the frame toward a focus point as the outgoing image punches in; at the peak it cuts to the incoming image, which settles back as the lines retract to the edges

params.name: center
params.note: Point the lines converge to, from (0, 0) at the bottom left to (1, 1) at the top right

params.name: density
params.note: Number of lines around the focus point

params.name: focus
params.note: Size of the clear area around the focus point at the peak, from almost nothing to the whole frame

params.name: zoom
params.note: How much the images punch in toward the focus point

transitions.name: Sphere
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image wraps itself onto a shaded ball that shrinks and rolls away, revealing the incoming image under its shadow

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the ball rolls away toward

params.name: size
params.note: Radius of the ball once wrapped, relative to the shorter side of the frame

params.name: shading
params.note: Strength of the light and shading on the ball

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the soft shadow the ball casts on the incoming image

transitions.name: SpiralBlockWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Square blocks switch to the incoming image one after another along a rectangular spiral, from the border inward or from the center outward

params.name: grid
params.note: Number of blocks (columns, rows)

params.name: inward
params.note: Spiral from the top left corner inward; false spirals from the center outward, ending at the top left corner

params.name: clockwise
params.note: Turn clockwise; false turns counterclockwise

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Duration of each block's fade, as a fraction of the transition

transitions.name: SpiralWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A spiral arm winds out from the center and widens to reveal the incoming image

params.name: turns
params.note: Number of turns of the spiral

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the arm's edges

params.name: clockwise
params.note: Wind clockwise; false winds counterclockwise

transitions.name: SplatterWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Splats of paint land one after another, each popping in with a spiky outline, flung droplets and a few drips running down, revealing the incoming image until they cover the frame

params.name: splats
params.note: Number of splats across the frame

params.name: spikiness
params.note: How long the spikes around each splat are

params.name: droplets
params.note: How many droplets are flung around each splat

params.name: drips
params.note: How far the paint drips run down

params.name: rim
params.note: How dark and glossy the rim of the splats is

params.name: seed
params.note: Random seed for the splats

transitions.name: SplitFlap
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame becomes a split-flap board: in each cell the top half of the outgoing image flips down on a hinge across the middle, cell after cell, its back bringing the bottom half of the incoming image

params.name: size
params.note: Number of cells (columns, rows)

params.name: stagger
params.note: Delay of the last cell's flip, as a part of the transition

params.name: randomness
params.note: How much the order of the cells is shuffled, from a wave across the board to random

params.name: flaps
params.note: Number of flaps that fall in each cell, the ones before the last showing other parts of the incoming image

params.name: gap
params.note: Width of the gaps between the cells, as a part of the frame's shorter side (the hinges get half of it)

params.name: perspective
params.note: Amount of perspective: the falling flaps grow as they come toward the viewer

params.name: shading
params.note: How much the flaps darken as they turn away from the light, and the shadows they cast

transitions.name: SplitSlideInHorizontal
transitions.author: OllyOllyOlly
transitions.description: The incoming image slides in as two halves moving horizontally in opposite directions

params.name: reverse
params.note: Swap the directions of the halves

transitions.name: SplitSlideInOutHorizontal
transitions.author: OllyOllyOlly
transitions.description: The halves of both images slide horizontally in opposite directions, out and in at once

params.name: reverse
params.note: Swap the directions of the halves

transitions.name: SplitSlideInOutVertical
transitions.author: OllyOllyOlly
transitions.description: The halves of both images slide vertically in opposite directions, out and in at once

params.name: reverse
params.note: Swap the directions of the halves

transitions.name: SplitSlideInVertical
transitions.author: OllyOllyOlly
transitions.description: The incoming image slides in as two halves moving vertically in opposite directions

params.name: reverse
params.note: Swap the directions of the halves

transitions.name: SplitSlideOutHorizontal
transitions.author: OllyOllyOlly
transitions.description: The outgoing image slides out as two halves moving horizontally in opposite directions

params.name: reverse
params.note: Swap the directions of the halves

transitions.name: SplitSlideOutVertical
transitions.author: OllyOllyOlly
transitions.description: The outgoing image slides out as two halves moving vertically in opposite directions

params.name: reverse
params.note: Swap the directions of the halves

transitions.name: SpotlightWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The stage lights go down on the outgoing image and a soft oval spotlight searches across it along a curved path, comes to rest and lights the incoming image inside it, then widens until the stage lights come back up on the incoming image

params.name: center
params.note: Point where the spotlight comes to rest and opens from

params.name: size
params.note: Width of the spotlight while it searches, in frame heights

params.name: darkness
params.note: How dark the stage gets around the spotlight

transitions.name: SquaresWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Squares grow along a diagonal sweep to reveal the incoming image

params.name: squares
params.note: Number of squares (columns, rows)

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction of the sweep

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the sweep

transitions.name: Squeeze
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is squeezed into a line with color separation, revealing the incoming one

params.name: colorSeparation
params.note: Amount of color separation

transitions.name: StarWipe
transitions.author: Ben Lucas
transitions.description: A growing star reveals the incoming image

params.name: border_thickness
params.note: Thickness of the star's border

params.name: star_center
params.note: Center of the star

transitions.name: StaticFade
transitions.author: Ben Lucas
transitions.description: Cuts to the incoming image halfway, hidden behind a burst of TV static

transitions.name: StaticWipe
transitions.author: Ben Lucas
transitions.description: A wipe from top to bottom with a band of TV static at its edge

params.name: u_transitionUpToDown
params.note: Wipe from top to bottom; false wipes from bottom to top

params.name: u_max_static_span
params.note: Maximum height of the static band

transitions.name: StereoViewer
transitions.author: Ted Schundler
transitions.description: Both images shrink into rounded cards that swap, like a stereo viewer toy

params.name: zoom
params.note: How much the images zoom out

transitions.name: StickySplit
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is pulled apart down the middle like melted cheese: the halves part slowly while the picture between them stretches into a gooey web, which opens into glossy strings that thin out, sag and snap one by one, until the halves slide off and leave the incoming image

params.name: strings
params.note: Number of strings across the height of the frame

params.name: sag
params.note: How much the strings sag under their weight

params.name: gloss
params.note: Strength of the shading, glossy highlight and shadow of the strings

params.name: seed
params.note: Random seed: another value gives other strings

transitions.name: StopMotion
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is a paper cutout that jerks off the frame in choppy stop-motion steps, with a tiny new tilt and offset each step and a drop shadow, while the incoming cutout jerks in the same way and lands

params.name: steps
params.note: Number of held poses during the transition: fewer is choppier

params.name: jitter
params.note: Size of the small random tilt and offset given to the cutouts at each step

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the drop shadow the cutouts cast

transitions.name: StretchSlide
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image stretches out long as it shoots away to one side, pulling in the incoming one squashed behind it, which overshoots and springs back to its shape

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction in which the images slide

params.name: stretch
params.note: How long the outgoing image stretches and how much the squashed incoming one bulges

params.name: bounce
params.note: How far the incoming image overshoots before it springs back to its shape

transitions.name: StripDatamoshGlitch
transitions.author: bread
transitions.description: A datamosh glitch: torn strips, chroma shifts and scan noise drag the outgoing image into the incoming one

transitions.name: Subdivide
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is cut in quick beats like a sheet under a guillotine, each piece cut again across its longer side at its own uneven point and pushed apart into floating cards, then the cards flip over one by one to the incoming image and the cuts close back in reverse order

params.name: gap
params.note: Width of the first cut's gap, in frame heights (each following cut opens a narrower one)

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the shadows the cards cast

transitions.name: Swap
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The two images swap places in 3D, with a floor reflection

params.name: reflection
params.note: Strength of the reflection

params.name: perspective
params.note: Amount of perspective

transitions.name: Swim
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image turns into a fish and swims out of the frame head first: its body narrows into a forked tail, a bending wave runs from its head to its tail and swings wider beat by beat, lighting and shading its flanks as it bends and driving it faster until it is gone, revealing the incoming image under its soft shadow

params.name: swing
params.note: How far the tail swings, as a part of the frame's short side

params.name: beats
params.note: Number of tail beats

params.name: taper
params.note: How much the body narrows toward the tail

params.name: shading
params.note: Strength of the shading on the bends and of the shadow

transitions.name: Swirl
transitions.author: Sergey Kosarevsky
transitions.description: The image twists into a round swirl around the center that peaks mid-way, where the outgoing image dissolves into the incoming one, then untwists

params.name: strength
params.note: Turns of the swirl at its center at the peak (negative turns clockwise)

params.name: radius
params.note: Radius of the swirl, in frame heights

transitions.name: TangentMotionBlur
transitions.author: chenkai
transitions.description: The outgoing image is flung away along a curve with motion blur

transitions.name: TileBlast
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image breaks into square tiles that blast toward the viewer from a point, the nearest ones first, each one tumbling and growing in perspective as it flies out past the frame, uncovering the incoming image behind them

params.name: rows
params.note: Number of rows of tiles

params.name: center
params.note: Point the tiles blast away from, in texture coordinates

params.name: spin
params.note: How much the tiles spin and tumble as they fly

params.name: shading
params.note: How much the tiles darken as they turn from the light, and the shadows they cast

transitions.name: TileConveyor
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Gaps open between the tiles of the outgoing image over a track that winds through every tile; the tiles glide along it like a train, the outgoing ones leaving at the bottom right while the incoming ones enter at the bottom left and wind through the frame until they settle in place

params.name: order
params.note: Size of the track: 2 to the power of order tiles along each side

params.name: gap
params.note: Width of the gaps between the tiles, as a part of a tile

params.name: shading
params.note: Strength of the bevel and of the shadow the tiles cast on the track

transitions.name: TileRings
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image is cut into tiles that ride concentric rectangular rings like the dials of a combination lock: the rings turn a quarter of the way round in alternating directions, the tiles turning the corners like links of a chain, then the tiles flip over to the incoming image in a ripple running round each ring, and the rings turn back until every tile clicks home

params.name: rings
params.note: Number of rings, from the border to the center

params.name: stagger
params.note: Delay between the innermost ring and the outermost one, as a part of the transition

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the shadows cast by the lifted tiles

transitions.name: TileShuffle
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The frame is cut into tiles that swap places in pairs, round after round along the rows then along the columns, one tile of each pair lifting to swing over the other with a soft shadow; each tile turns to the incoming image during one of its swaps, so the incoming picture arrives scrambled and the last rounds sort it out

params.name: tiles
params.note: Number of tiles along the longer side of the frame (the tiles stay about square)

params.name: gap
params.note: Width of the gaps that open between the tiles, as a part of a tile

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the shadows the tiles cast

transitions.name: TilesWave
transitions.author: numb3r23
transitions.description: The incoming image is revealed tile by tile in a diagonal wave

params.name: tileCount
params.note: Number of tiles (columns, rows)

transitions.name: TopBottom
transitions.author: zhmy
transitions.description: The outgoing image shrinks away upward while the incoming one slides in from the bottom

transitions.name: TriangleFlip
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The image is cut into a mosaic of triangles that turn over in perspective in a wave spreading from a point, each one rolling away from it about one of its three axes, catching a glint of light and casting a soft shadow, and showing its part of the incoming image on its back

params.name: rows
params.note: Number of rows of triangles across the height of the frame

params.name: center
params.note: Point the wave of flips spreads from (0,0 is the bottom left corner, 1,1 the top right one)

params.name: stagger
params.note: How long the wave takes to cross the frame, as a part of the transition: 0 turns every triangle at once

params.name: shading
params.note: Strength of the light and shadows on the turning triangles and of the shade in the holes they leave

transitions.name: TruchetWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A grid of square tiles, each holding two quarter-circle arcs, links into long winding paths; starting from the middle and spreading outward, the paths are drawn as thin lines of the incoming image, then thicken into bands with a dark outline and a soft shadow until they merge over the whole frame

params.name: cells
params.note: Number of tiles across the frame's height

params.name: outline
params.note: Strength of the dark outline and of the shadow along the bands

params.name: spread
params.note: How much the paths are staggered from the middle outward: 0 draws them all at once

transitions.name: Tumble
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is thrown away like a rigid card, tumbling end over end with a slight spin as it flies off into the distance in perspective, its darker back showing on every flip and its soft shadow shrinking on the incoming image behind it

params.name: flips
params.note: Number of turns end over end, negative to tumble the other way

params.name: spin
params.note: Turns of the secondary spin around the line of sight

params.name: direction
params.note: Where the card flies toward on screen, in frame heights from the center

params.name: perspective
params.note: Strength of the perspective

params.name: shading
params.note: Shading of the card as it turns, darkness of its back and of its shadow

transitions.name: Tunnel
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera flies down a tunnel lined with the outgoing image toward the incoming one, which opens at its far end and grows to fill the frame

params.name: speed
params.note: How far and fast the camera flies down the tunnel

params.name: twist
params.note: How much the walls spiral as they rush by

transitions.name: TvLostSignal
transitions.author: mernking (gitlab.com/Godswork)
transitions.description: A crossfade with drifting tracking lines and tearing, like a TV losing its signal

transitions.name: TvRoll
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image rolls faster and faster, like an old TV losing its vertical hold, then the roll slows down and locks on the incoming image

params.name: rolls
params.note: Number of frames that roll by

params.name: barHeight
params.note: Height of the bar between the frames

transitions.name: TvStatic
transitions.author: Brandon Anzaldi
transitions.description: Cuts to full-screen TV static, then to the incoming image

params.name: offset
params.note: Part of the transition, at each end, that shows the images instead of static

transitions.name: TvTurnOff
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image collapses into a glowing line and a dot, like an old TV turned off, then the incoming image powers on from the dot

params.name: glow
params.note: Strength of the glow around the line and the dot

transitions.name: Unbox
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image is tossed in folded up as an open card box, its middle the floor and its borders the walls, lands with a small bounce after its shadow, then its walls fall open flat one pair after the other, each with a bounce, until the unfolded sheet covers the frame

params.name: depth
params.note: Height of the walls, as a part of the frame's shorter side: the borders of the incoming image that fold up

params.name: perspective
params.note: Strength of the perspective

params.name: shading
params.note: How much the faces darken away from the light, and the shadows they cast

transitions.name: UndulatingBurnOut
transitions.author: pthrasher
transitions.description: A circle with a wavy edge burns out from the center to reveal the incoming image

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the edge

params.name: center
params.note: Center of the circle

transitions.name: Vaporize
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image goes up in smoke: from one side, the picture itself turns to vapour that rises over what is still intact, curls into wisps and pales as it thins out, revealing the incoming image underneath

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the vapour rises toward (the image starts turning to vapour on the opposite side)

params.name: rise
params.note: How high the vapour rises above the image before it is gone, in frame heights

params.name: swirl
params.note: How much the vapour swirls and curls as it rises

transitions.name: VerticalClose
transitions.author: martiniti
transitions.description: The incoming image closes in from the left and right edges toward the middle

transitions.name: VerticalOpen
transitions.author: martiniti
transitions.description: The incoming image opens from a line in the middle toward the left and right edges

transitions.name: VhsTracking
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Tape-tracking bands of white snow roll down the frame, tearing the lines around them, with smeared color, wobbling lines, a jittering strip at the bottom and a dropout flash, as the incoming image is recorded over the outgoing one under the densest band

params.name: bands
params.note: Number of noise bands rolling down (the first one carries the cut)

params.name: noise
params.note: Amount of snow and tearing in the bands

params.name: bleed
params.note: How far the color smears to the right of the picture

params.name: wobble
params.note: How much the lines wobble sideways

transitions.name: ViscousFingers
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image is pushed into the outgoing one like air into oil squeezed between two glass plates: a bubble grows into a few rounded fingers that keep splitting in two at their tips, shoving the old picture aside into thin glossy threads, until the fingers swell and close the last gaps

params.name: center
params.note: Where the incoming image is pushed in

params.name: fingers
params.note: Number of fingers leaving the first bubble

transitions.name: Vortex
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image breaks into hundreds of small squares that a tornado carries away along a spiral around the center, from the eye outward, uncovering the incoming image

params.name: grid
params.note: Number of rows of squares

params.name: spin
params.note: Turns each square makes around the center as it flies away (negative turns clockwise)

params.name: randomness
params.note: How randomly the squares leave: 0 from the center outward, 1 in any order

transitions.name: WarpSpeed
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera jumps to light speed: star streaks shoot out from the center and stretch longer and longer while the outgoing image is pulled into a radial smear, then after a flash the incoming image emerges from the center as the streaks shrink back

params.name: center
params.note: Point the camera flies toward, from (0, 0) at the bottom left to (1, 1) at the top right

params.name: streaks
params.note: Number of star streaks around the center

params.name: strength
params.note: Length of the streaks and of the radial smear

params.name: flash
params.note: Brightness of the flash at the peak of the jump

transitions.name: WatercolorDissolve
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The outgoing image is washed off into wet paper, then the incoming one is painted in watercolor: pale washes spread first, blooming where the paint is still wet and drying with darker edges and grainy pigment, then deeper glazes go on, darkest tones first, until the picture is complete

params.name: edges
params.note: How dark the edges of the washes dry, where the pigment gathers

params.name: blooms
params.note: Amount of blooms: lighter flowers of paint with frilly dark edges, where water runs back into a wet wash

params.name: granulation
params.note: How much the pigment settles into the grain of the paper

transitions.name: WaterDrop
transitions.author: Paweł Płóciennik
transitions.description: A drop falls into the image like into still water: round ripples spread out from where it hits, bending the image with glints on their slopes, the incoming image shows up inside the leading ripple, and the water calms down

params.name: amplitude
params.note: Frequency of the ripples: higher makes them closer together

params.name: speed
params.note: Speed of the ripples as they run outward through the spreading rings

params.name: center
params.note: Where the drop falls, in texture coordinates

params.name: refraction
params.note: How far the ripples bend the image, in frame heights

params.name: highlight
params.note: Brightness of the glints on the ripples

transitions.name: WaterfallWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Blocks of the incoming image pour down from above the frame column after column, like a waterfall: in each column they fall one behind the other, land with a small bounce and stack up from the bottom, casting soft shadows on the outgoing image until the stack fills the frame

params.name: columns
params.note: Number of columns (the blocks stay about square, with at most 48 rows)

params.name: stagger
params.note: Share of the transition over which the columns start one after another (0 pours them all together)

params.name: bounce
params.note: How high the blocks bounce as they land

params.name: shadow
params.note: Darkness of the shadows and of the edges of the falling blocks

params.name: reverse
params.note: The columns pour from right to left instead of left to right

transitions.name: WaveWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A breaking wave crashes across the frame, its lip curling over in front of its face and throwing foam and spray ahead, its shadow darkening the outgoing image; the incoming image is left behind it, tinted and bent by the water, clearing as the wave passes

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction the wave travels toward

params.name: curl
params.note: Size of the curling lip, in wave heights: how far it overhangs ahead of the face

params.name: foam
params.note: Amount of foam on the crest and spray thrown ahead of it

params.name: refraction
params.note: How much the water bends the incoming image behind the wave

transitions.name: WedgeWipe
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: Two hands sweep away from each other around the center, opening a widening wedge that reveals the incoming image

params.name: angle
params.note: Direction the wedge opens from, in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the hands' edges

params.name: center
params.note: Point the hands turn around

transitions.name: WhipPan
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A fast camera pan that streaks both images with motion blur, the incoming one arriving from the opposite side

params.name: direction
params.note: Direction in which the images move

params.name: blur
params.note: Length of the motion blur at full speed

transitions.name: WhipSpin
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera rolls faster and faster around the center of the frame, streaking the outgoing image in a spin blur, then the incoming one takes over mid-spin and slows to a stop

params.name: turns
params.note: Total rotation, in turns, split between the two images (negative turns clockwise)

params.name: blur
params.note: Length of the motion blur along the spin

params.name: chroma
params.note: How much the color channels split apart as the spin speeds up

params.name: zoom
params.note: How much the camera zooms in at the fastest point

transitions.name: WhipTilt
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The camera tilts fast from the outgoing image to the incoming one, set edge to edge at an angle above it, streaking both in perspective with a vertical motion blur

params.name: down
params.note: Tilt the camera down to an incoming image below instead of above

params.name: blur
params.note: Length of the motion blur along the tilt

params.name: chroma
params.note: How much the color channels split apart as the tilt speeds up

params.name: perspective
params.note: Strength of the perspective (field of view of the camera)

transitions.name: Wind
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: A ragged left-to-right wipe, as if the image was blown away by the wind

params.name: size
params.note: Width of the ragged edge

params.name: reversed
params.note: Wipe from right to left instead

transitions.name: WindowBlinds
transitions.author: Fabien Benetou
transitions.description: A crossfade through horizontal window blinds

transitions.name: WindowSlices
transitions.author: gre
transitions.description: The incoming image appears through vertical slices that widen

params.name: count
params.note: Number of slices

params.name: smoothness
params.note: Softness of the slices' edges

transitions.name: ZoomInCircles
transitions.author: dycm8009
transitions.description: Concentric rings of the outgoing image zoom at different speeds before revealing the incoming one

transitions.name: ZoomInOut
transitions.author: OllyOllyOlly
transitions.description: Zooms into the outgoing image until it blurs into a flat color, then out to the incoming one

transitions.name: ZoomWipeLeft
transitions.author: Handk
transitions.description: Zooms into the outgoing image, then the incoming one wipes in from right to left

params.name: zoom_quickness
params.note: Part of the first half spent zooming (capped at 0.5)

transitions.name: ZoomWipeRight
transitions.author: Handk
transitions.description: Zooms into the outgoing image, then the incoming one wipes in from left to right

params.name: zoom_quickness
params.note: Part of the first half spent zooming (capped at 0.5)
